statement: The strict-hydration fixture supplies the canonical router and cache dependencies so the real cache-hydration phase reaches its required-table verifier and refuses the mode swap for missing SERVICES.

constraints.statement: Only test/bootstrap/cache-hydration-strictness.test.js changes behavior. Supply one explicit router object shared with CDC and actual SystemTableCache with the same four existing rows; keep SERVICES absent. Do not add a production fallback, override latency setup, alter hydration/no-swap assertions or change a timeout.

Real latency owners started by the phase are stopped through LatencyTopologySetup.stop in teardown. Retain the missing-router red and router-only/get-missing red as fixture evidence. Existing latency topology delegation control and independent review precede closure.
